vxPath.description: the file that ran: the compiled binary, or the source entry

handedOffFrom.description: the vx that handed this call to the project's own (VX_HANDED_OFF); null when none did

bunSupported.description: false below the Bun vx needs (engines.bun)

git.description: git's version; null when git is not found

gitStatusCache.description: the git settings that speed up the status vx reads; null when git could not answer

projects.description: how many projects the workspace has

plugins.description: each loaded plugin, in declared order

seams.description: the pipeline stages it fills, in pipeline order

workers.description: the worker count a run defaults to, and where it comes from

source.description: env: VX_RUN_CONCURRENCY; workspace: run.concurrency; cgroup: the CPU quota; cores: the CPU count

cores.description: the cores this process may use

cpuQuota.description: the cgroup CPU quota, in cores; null when none binds

cgroupLimitBytes.description: the cgroup memory limit; null when none binds

cacheDirBytes.description: bytes on disk under cacheDir: the index and run history, and the entries when no store holds them

cacheStore.description: the shared store holding the entries; null when cacheDir holds them

cacheStoreBytes.description: bytes on disk under cacheStore, shared by the workspace's checkouts; null with no store

cacheVersion.description: the cache's version, part of every key

cacheEntries.description: how many entries the local cache holds

cacheIndexError.description: Why the cache index cannot be read, with the fix; null when it reads. While set, the counts it holds read 0.

settings.description: every setting (docs/schema.md § Settings) by path, as a run with no flags takes it: its variable as written, else .vx/workspace's value (source plugin when a plugin's config hook set it), else null with source default

value.description: the value a run takes; null for the default

source.description: env: its variable; workspace: .vx/workspace; plugin: a config hook; default: none set it

plugin.description: the plugin whose config hook set it; only with source plugin

refused.description: why a run refuses the variable's value; absent when a run takes it

orphans.description: artifacts on disk no entry names; vx cache clean removes them

runs24h.description: task runs recorded in the last 24 hours, hits included

restored24h.description: of hits24h, the hits that restored outputs; the rest were up to date

flakyTasks.description: tasks the retained history shows failing on a key that had passed; empty when none

keys.description: distinct cache keys that failed after they had passed

lockError.description: Why a run refuses the lock that is there (run `vx lock`); null when a run reads it or there is none.

workspaceError.description: Why .vx/workspace did not load (a syntax error, a plugin hook that threw); null when it loads. While set, the facts the file decides read as with no file, and vx info exits 1.

sandbox.description: whether this host can run exec.sandbox, and how many tasks declare one

available.description: whether a task here can run with exec.sandbox

reason.description: why no task here can; empty when available

declared.description: how many loaded tasks declare exec.sandbox

untraced.description: why the sandbox cannot report the reads it denied; null when it can
